facts.fact: Vendor cites an IAS Streaming Wars report stating that 88% of consumers have access to a connected TV.
facts.quote: Now, 88% of consumers have access to a connected TV.

facts.fact: The vendor's CTV survey, conducted with Advertiser Perceptions, covered over 200 agency and brand advertising decision makers.
facts.quote: of over 200 agency and brand advertising decision makers

facts.fact: According to the vendor's recent CTV report, 75% of marketers believe CTV is a cutting-edge way to promote their brands.
facts.quote: According to our recent CTV report, 75% of marketers believe that CTV is a cutting-edge way for them to promote their brands.

facts.fact: Connected TV is defined as a subset of OTT, covering apps and services that do not require traditional cable or pay-TV subscriptions.
facts.quote: Connected TV is a subset of OTT, which includes apps and services that do not require subscriptions to traditional cable or pay-TV services.

facts.fact: Per the vendor's CTV report, 4 out of 5 CTV viewers in the US choose ad-supported content over paying to remove ads.
facts.quote: 4 out of 5 CTV viewers in the US and 7 out 10 in Europe opt to stick with ad-supported content.

facts.fact: In the vendor's CTV report, 51% of respondents are increasing their allocation toward audience-based buying.
facts.quote: which found that 51% of respondents are increasing their allocation toward audience-based buying

facts.fact: Citing Vericast, 80% of US households have at least one CTV device.
facts.quote: have at least one CTV device which means that CTV is reaching viewers of all ages

facts.fact: The vendor's CTV report found that a majority of marketers have been advertising on CTV for under 3 years.
facts.quote: a majority of marketers have been advertising on CTV for under 3 years

facts.fact: Citing eMarketer, households with a connected TV device are projected to climb to 87% by 2025.
facts.quote: households with a connected TV device will climb to 87% by 2025
